title: Running the Mobile Agent Loop from Planning Through Pull Request
summary: kazutoyo@TellerNovel documents a React Native workflow that takes an agent from an agreed plan through implementation, tests, iOS Simulator and Android Emulator checks, and a screenshot-backed pull request. Pure logic, Storybook states, lint rules, named accessibility targets, and replayable agent-device traces make failures deterministic enough for the agent to diagnose and recheck.
takeaway: Make one feature agent-verifiable end to end: separate pure logic and UI states, name interactive elements, save failed device flows for replay, and reserve physical-device feel for human review.
